scope: Disposable GitHub Actions windows-2025 runner: Windows Server 2025 build 26100, Windows PowerShell 5.1.26100.33438, Python 3.14.8, elevated administrator. Diagnostic labs only; not product qualification, not an interactive Windows 11 session, not a Windows client SKU.
question: How close can Windows per-application isolation get to the Linux loopback-only network namespace, and does a zero-capability AppContainer with a package-SID WFP filter help?

dns.why: Contained modes m2, m3 and m4 produced no probe result because CreateProcessW failed with error 203 under the minimal environment block; only the uncontained modes ran. The run says nothing about containment.

crash.why: icacls /T /Q exited 5 on the package grant, so the lab aborted before any browser ran.

recover.why: The foreign negative control, built through the product Guard with a marker override, tripped the product identity check (sublayer identity conflict) and could not be removed (FwpmProviderDeleteByKey0 0x8032000a, in use); cleanup_ok was false on the disposable runner.

dns.method: pktmon on all NICs with a UDP/53 filter, converted to pcapng (165 frames); unique nonce names per API and mode; modes: m1 outside before, m2 zero-capability AppContainer, m3 zero-capability AppContainer plus package-SID WFP filter, m4 AppContainer with internetClient (positive control), m5 outside after.
caveats: Resolve-DnsName timed out in every mode including outside the container, so that probe is invalid and proves nothing.
DnsQuery_W returned status 87 in m2 and m3 but 9501 in m1, m4 and m5; the cause of the different failure path is not established.
Only DNS was captured. Direct TCP and UDP from the container, public IPv6 and other brokers were not measured.
Drop reason and component were not parsed; a zero NIC count does not prove which layer stopped the request.
Because m2 and m3 are identical, the package-SID WFP filter was neither shown to be needed nor to help for DNS.

crash.method: Browser started suspended inside a zero-capability AppContainer with a loopback exemption, cdb attached before resume, uncontained controls for each browser; ACL grant to the package succeeded (icacls exit 0).
crash.controls: Chrome, Edge and Firefox rendered the fixture outside the container (exit 0).

chrome.outcome: fatal exit 0x80000003 within about 0.01 s in the logging row
chrome.first_fault: [FATAL:third_party\crashpad\crashpad\client\crashpad_client_win.cc:330] Check failed: . CreateNamedPipe: Access is denied. (0x5), then chrome_elf!base::ImmediateCrash

edge.outcome: access violation 0xc0000005 in the browser process, headless and headed, also with --no-sandbox
edge.first_fault: msedge!windows_task_manager::WindowsTaskManagerHandler::UpdateTasks+0x102, read of address 0x18 (null pointer), called from base::OneShotTimer::RunUserTask on the browser UI thread
edge.note: The headed contained row reached the lab loopback proxy once (fixture_requests 1) before it crashed.

firefox.detail: GeckoChildProcessHost.cpp:837 Failed to launch socket subprocess and tab subprocess @InitializeChannel (Error:0)

crash.caveat: The debugger-attached contained rows ran until the harness timeout; they were captured by cdb, whose loader snaps slow the process. The no-debugger logging rows show the same Chrome failure.

established: scripts/windows-network-recover.ps1 under Windows PowerShell 5.1 -Json finds, reports and removes WFP objects created by the product Guard (20 PERMIT filters, sublayer, provider).
A foreign provider, sublayer and 20 filters with an unrelated marker stayed byte-identical in the raw snapshot after two -Apply runs.
A dead loopback manual proxy was reset (ProxyEnable 0, ProxyServer kept) and HKCU proxy values and WinINet flags were restored exactly.
An NRPT rule outside the root namespace is reported as residue (exit 3 on -Apply) and is not removed.
not_tested: Positive removal of a root-namespace NRPT rule.

conclusions: A zero-capability AppContainer put no DNS query on the network adapter for the six working resolver probes, while an internetClient container and uncontained processes did; this is real packet evidence for DNS only.
Running the whole stock Chrome, Edge or Firefox inside that container failed for all three at different application-internal points, so this route does not give browser compatibility.
Because each failure is specific to its application, nothing here shows that arbitrary local programs run inside such a container; compatibility has to be established per program.
The recovery script is verified against product-made objects on Windows PowerShell 5.1.
No result in this directory shows Linux-equivalent isolation on Windows.
not_established: Direct TCP, UDP and public IPv6 egress from the zero-capability container were not packet-tested here.
The loopback exemption lets the container reach other 127.0.0.1 ports; this follows from how the exemption works and was not measured.
No non-browser application other than the lab probes was run in the container in these labs.
Interactive Windows 11 desktop behavior, real public exit IP, login flows and downloads were not tested.
Why Chrome gets Access denied on CreateNamedPipe inside the container is not explained; the Crashpad pipe security descriptor is documented to include ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES.
evidence_policy: Original failed and invalid reports stay as recorded. Each result applies only to its own source commit and runner image.
